description: This Java class 'RemotePlayer' manages media playback via remote routes, supporting operations like play, pause, resume, stop, enqueue, remove, and status updates, utilizing Android's media routing and remote playback APIs.

classes.name: RemotePlayer
classes.description: A class that handles remote media playback, supporting queuing and session management, and providing playback controls.

methods.name: RemotePlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RemotePlayer with application context.

methods.name: isRemotePlayback
methods.description: Returns true indicating this is a remote playback implementation.

methods.name: isQueuingSupported
methods.description: Checks if queuing is supported by the remote playback client.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified media route and initializes the remote playback client.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the remote playback client.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of a media item on the remote route.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within a media item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a media item.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and ends the session if supported.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a media item for playback if queuing is supported.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a media item from the queue.

methods.name: updateStatistics
methods.description: Requests and updates playback statistics from the route.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns the current playback statistics information.

methods.name: enqueueInternal
methods.description: Internal method to enqueue a media item.

methods.name: seekInternal
methods.description: Internal method to perform seek operation.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new playback session.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Ends the current playback session.

methods.name: logStatus
methods.description: Logs status updates for debugging.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages.

methods.name: throwIfNoSession
methods.description: Throws exception if there is no active session.

methods.name: throwIfQueuingUnsupported
methods.description: Throws exception if queuing is not supported.
